beats: Every day my news video opened the same way — a generic stock photo, twenty seconds of nothing, before a single real headline showed up.
Viewers sat through a slow, content-free intro before seeing anything I'd actually written that day.
Now it cuts straight from one spoken line into the real photos of today's top three stories.
The cut lands exactly on the right word, timed with Remotion to match the voice.
That's eighteen seconds of dead air gone from every episode.
